name: grant_unit_promotion
description: Grant a specific promotion to any unit (any player's) without spending a promotion level, via Unit:GetExperience():SetPromotion(index) in GameCore_Tuner (Firaxis Debug/Unit.ltp promotion list). Params: unitId (required), promotion (PROMOTION_* type from GameInfo.UnitPromotions, required), playerId (unit owner, default local player). Returns HasPromotion before/after and the unit's full promotion list. Verified live turn 60: PROMOTION_VOLLEY on a test Archer flipped HasPromotion false -> true in both GameCore and InGame (InGame GetLevel became 1); XP and CanPromote unchanged. No remove function exists in GameCore (irreversible except by deleting the unit); the function does not check the promotion class matches the unit - pass only promotions valid for the unit's class.
lua:
local pid = P.playerId or Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local pl = Players[pid]
if not pl then emitJson({error="no player "..tostring(pid)}); return end
local u = pl:GetUnits():FindID(P.unitId)
if not u then emitJson({error="no unit "..tostring(P.unitId).." for player "..tostring(pid)}); return end
local row = GameInfo.UnitPromotions[P.promotion]
if not row then emitJson({error="unknown promotion "..tostring(P.promotion)}); return end
local xp = u:GetExperience()
local before = xp:HasPromotion(row.Index)
if not before and not (P.dryRun) then xp:SetPromotion(row.Index) end
local after = xp:HasPromotion(row.Index)
local list = {}
for r in GameInfo.UnitPromotions() do if xp:HasPromotion(r.Index) then table.insert(list, r.UnitPromotionType) end end
emitJson({unitId=P.unitId, unitType=GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType, promotion=row.UnitPromotionType, promotionClass=row.PromotionClass, hadBefore=before, hasAfter=after, promotions=list, xp=xp:GetExperiencePoints(), canPromote=xp:CanPromote()})
